visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of people (portrait, name with credentials, role, phone/email contacts and a Read More profile link)

contentPattern.structure: one row per person: cell 1 portrait image, cell 2 body with a heading (name and credentials), a role paragraph, phone (tel:) and email (mailto:) links as a list or paragraphs, optional bio text and a Read More / Contact link paragraph

usage: Management and executive team grids on the About page, Meet the team / contacts on industry, service and office pages; single contact cards on webinar and personnel pages (boxed, boxed-2)
reuseGuidance: Use for any list of people with portrait and contacts. Use boxed for a single contact card with a top rule, boxed-2 for a single contact card in a grey band. For a full personnel profile header use profile-contact.
